name: Newton Coin
detailed_description:
Update the client to log in to the latest version!

Newton Coin
This is a clicker game. In the game, you need to click on the Coin. You can obtain a random Newton - themed gold coin every three hours. With effort and luck, you can keep expanding your gold coin collection!
Drop rates every three hours*:

  • Common: 70%

  • Frequent: 25%

  • Uncommon: 4.89%

  • Rare: 0.1%

  • Epic: 0.01%

  • Ultra - rare: 1 in 400,000

  • Legendary: 1 in 10,000,000

There is absolutely no synthesis function. The drop rates are stable, and the top - tier Coins are limited!
Features: This is first and foremost a free and fun game for collecting Newton coins, and secondly, a clicker game. It has a simple program that consumes few resources, so you can use it with confidence. Rely on your effort and luck to acquire your great Newton coins!
